title: 第3692章 铁血将军情感懦夫第3691章 我们对你的遭遇深表遗憾
lines: 在这清河县，谁会对自己公子出手？
若是其他仇人来寻仇，也不至于等到清河县才动手，在路上就有机会。
再者，公子并未与其他超凡以上的强者有什么深仇大恨。
福伯怀疑，凶手就是清河县的人。
或者说，是清河县某人指使！
有这个本事的，整个清河县，除了秦都尉，只有李总旗。
秦都尉在军中官至正四品，当年有许多出生入死的军中兄弟，如今都身居高职。
他是有能力请来超凡强者出手的。
还有李总旗。
他虽然只是一个小小总旗，实力也才三境初期，可他有个对他极好的叔父。
他的叔父乃是五境宗师级镇魔司千户。
这样的强者，也是有能力驱使超凡者对公子出手的！
“诸位，可有发现什么蛛丝马迹？”
福伯的眼神无比的犀利，扫视四周，仔细搜寻，眼中闪烁着精光。
但四周实在太干净了，什么都看不到。
他的目光回到了李总旗等人的脸上，仿佛要从他们的眼神中看出些什么来。
“行凶者手段很高明，并未留下痕迹，因此我们没有找到什么线索。”
李总旗这般回应。
他从福伯的眼神之中看出来了，江远的这个家仆在怀疑自己。
“李总旗！我们家公子是在你们负责的清河县出的事情，你要给我们江家一个交代！”
福伯言辞之间咄咄逼人，脸色铁青，每个字几乎是咬着牙说出来的。
“江百户在清河县出了事，我们自是会查。
但你说交代，你不过只是江家一个仆人，有什么资格在本总旗面前吆喝？
念在你护主心切，此次可不与你计较，但你要记住自己的身份！”
李总旗脸色有些冷，话语很不客气。
“哼！公子的事情，江家不会善罢甘休！
什么人都敢骑到江家的头上了吗？
伤江家公子，必付出代价！”
福伯眼神阴冷至极，胸膛剧烈起伏。
公子这般伤势，前途尽毁，终生残废，实在太惨了。
老爷知道后，若是怪罪下来，自己恐怕也会被迁怒！
“只等查到凶手，自是会让其为自己的行为付出代价。”
李总旗平静地说道。
福伯闻言，眼睛冷幽幽地看着李总旗，并没有说话，但眼神之中藏着的意思却很明显。
“江百户如此遭遇，我们深表同情。
但你不要将怒火转移到我们身上。
我还是那句话，你不过一家仆，摆什么架子？”
江远嘶哑的声音传入福伯的耳中。
福伯转身看向江远，嘴颤动了几下。
随即，他看向李总旗等人，“既然诸位已经检查过现场，那就请离开吧！

;;
In Qinghe County, who would take action against his son?
If other enemies come to seek revenge, they won't wait until Qinghe County to take action. There will be opportunities on the way.
Furthermore, the young master does not have any deep enmity with other powerful people above the extraordinary level.
Uncle Fu suspected that the murderer was from Qinghe County.
In other words, it was someone in Qinghe County who ordered it!
Except for Qin Duwei, the only person with this ability in Qinghe County is Mr. Li Qi.
Qin Duwei is a senior officer in the military, up to the fourth rank. Many brothers in the military who fought through life and death back then are now in high positions.
He has the ability to invite extraordinary powerful people to take action.
And Mr. Li Qi.
Although he is only a small general and his strength is only at the early stage of the Three Realms, he has an uncle who is very good to him.
His uncle is Qianhu, the master-level demon-suppressing master of the Five Realms.
Such a strong man also has the ability to drive extraordinary beings to attack the young master!
"Everyone, have you found any clues?"
Fu Bo's eyes were extremely sharp. He scanned the surroundings and searched carefully, his eyes sparkling.
But the surroundings were so clean that I couldn't see anything.
His eyes returned to the faces of General Li Qi and others, as if he wanted to see something in their eyes.
"The perpetrator was very clever and did not leave any traces, so we found no clues."
General Li Qi responded like this.
He could tell from Uncle Fu's eyes that Jiang Yuan's servant was doubting him.
"Mr. Li Qi! What happened to our young master in Qinghe County, which is your responsibility, you have to give an explanation to our Jiang family!"
Uncle Fu's words were aggressive, his face was ashen, and he almost said every word through gritted teeth.
"If something happens to Jiang Baihu in Qinghe County, we will investigate.
But as you said, you are just a servant of the Jiang family. What qualifications do you have to shout in front of this general?
Because of your eagerness to protect the Lord, I won’t argue with you this time, but you must remember your identity! "
Mr. Li Qi's face was a little cold and his words were very rude.
"Hmph! The Jiang family will not let go of the young master's matter!
Does anyone dare to ride on the Jiang family's head?
If you hurt Young Master Jiang, you must pay the price! "
Fu Bo's eyes were extremely cold, and his chest heaved violently.
It is really tragic that the young master is so injured, his future is ruined, and he is disabled for life.
After the master finds out, if he is blamed, he will probably be angry too!
"As long as the murderer is found, he will be made to pay the price for his actions."
Mr. Li said calmly.
When Uncle Fu heard this, he looked at Mr. Li Qi with cold eyes and said nothing, but the meaning hidden in his eyes was obvious.
“We deeply sympathize with Jiang Baihu for what he has been through.
But don't turn your anger on us.
I still say the same thing, you are just a servant, why are you putting on airs? "
"Uncle Fu..."
Jiang Yuan's hoarse voice reached Uncle Fu's ears.
Uncle Fu turned around and looked at Jiang Yuan, his mouth trembling a few times.
Immediately, he looked at General Li Qi and others, "Since you have inspected the scene, please leave!
